intro.en: Custom low-pressure molding integrates a defined electronic or cable insert with a thermoplastic protective body while controlling component exposure, interfaces, tooling contact and the complete assembly validation plan.
intro.zh: 定制低压成型把规定的电子或线缆嵌件与热塑性保护体整合，同时控制元件承受、接口边界、工装接触及完整组件验证计划。

knowledge.en: Low pressure describes a process approach, not an automatic guarantee of electronics safety, sealing or service life. Resin, insert, geometry and process window must be reviewed together.
knowledge.zh: 低压描述的是一种工艺路径，并不自动保证电子元件安全、密封或使用寿命；树脂、嵌件、几何与工艺窗口必须一起审核。

notes.en: Provide the bare insert, component map, keep-out zones, cable and connector interfaces, service environment, coverage boundary, quantity and required verification.
notes.zh: 请提供裸嵌件、元件地图、禁压区、线缆与连接器接口、使用环境、覆盖边界、数量及所需验证。

delivery.en: Release records the insert revision, resin identity, material preparation, tooling, process window, critical dimensions and agreed electrical, mechanical and environmental evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录嵌件版本、树脂身份、材料准备、工装、工艺窗口、关键尺寸与约定的电气、机械及环境证据。

subtitle.en: Shape the protective shell around the electronics
subtitle.zh: 围绕电子组件塑造保护外壳

lead.en: Define coverage, access and safe insert limits before choosing resin or tooling.
lead.zh: 在选择树脂与工装之前，先定义覆盖、可接近性与嵌件安全边界。
